question: Are there any trends in rental prices in Kreuzberg over the past few years leading up to 2024?
search_query: Trends in rental prices in Kreuzberg, Berlin, over the past few years leading up to 2024.
answer:
In analyzing rental prices in Kreuzberg leading up to 2024, we can observe a trend of increasing average cold rent over the past few years. 

- In October 2022, the average cold rent was 20.9 EUR/m²/month.
- By December 2022, it had risen to 21.3 EUR/m²/month.
- In December 2023, the average cold rent increased further to 22.21 EUR/m²/month.
- Moving into 2024, the average cold rent continued to rise, reaching 23.32 EUR/m²/month in October 2024 and slightly decreasing to 23.22 EUR/m²/month by December 2024.

This data indicates a general upward trend in rental prices in Kreuzberg, with the average cold rent increasing from 20.9 EUR/m²/month in late 2022 to around 23.22-23.32 EUR/m²/month by the end of 2024 (source: monthly market statistics for Kreuzberg).
